objective: render one descriptive global atlas map and one reproducible photo bar without using species identity or colour outcomes to select displayed photographs

map.included_rows: every automated_colour_state_admitted atlas observation with finite unstandardized flower L, a and b values
map.point_colour: CIELAB flower mean converted deterministically to clipped sRGB
map.role: descriptive display only; the inferential result comes from species-conditioned transition surfaces and the frozen joint null

photo_bar.eligible_rows: the same admitted finite-colour rows used by the map
photo_bar.selection_rule: sort by longitude, then latitude, then measurement_id; choose the 48 ranks nearest i*(n-1)/47 for i=0..47 using floor(x+0.5)
photo_bar.crop_rule: rerun the exact committed ROI-v4 estimator on each selected image; crop the box containing the central 90 percent of the original-orientation flower-mask mass with 12 percent padding and square-fit to 320 x 320 pixels
photo_bar.failure_rule: if any selected admitted image, image hash or rerun mask cannot be reproduced, stop the photo-bar build without replacement; do not choose a neighbouring image

outputs.determinism: both formats are regenerated from the same frozen map table, selected images, crop audit and executable
outputs.manifest: hash every input table, selected source image, crop, executable and output figure

claim_ceiling: The map and photo bar display automated camera-space flower-candidate colours without species labels. They are not evidence for a universal boundary, calibrated reflectance, pollinator perception, visitation, adaptation, selection or causation.
